) said on Thursday that it has notified Charming Medical
that its securities will be delisted from the stock exchange, effective November 9, 2026, unless the company appeals to a listing qualifications hearings panel.
The securities will remain halted and unavailable to trade until any appeal is resolved, the Nasdaq added.
Following removal from Nasdaq, the securities may be eligible for trading in the over-the-counter market.
Trading in the company's shares was halted on November 26, 2025, following a temporary trading suspension in the company’s securities by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

title: Nasdaq notifies Charming Medical of anticipated delisting
